confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bruges, a tourist-heavy Belgian city with a price premium over inland cities; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which is the most volatile and most seasonal. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Ghent and Leuven for restaurant and drink prices, adjusted upward for Bruges' tourist premium. Accommodation is benchmarked against other Belgian and Dutch historic tourist cities in peak summer.
